description: This file contains utility functions for handling selectors, attribute matching, and text content extraction within DOM elements, specifically for use in a web automation or testing context.

methods.name: matchesComponentAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an object matches a component attribute based on a JSON path and attribute criteria.

methods.name: matchesAttributePart
methods.description: Determines if a value matches a specific attribute selector part, supporting various operators.

methods.name: shouldSkipForTextMatching
methods.description: Decides whether an element should be skipped during text matching, such as script or style tags.

methods.name: elementText
methods.description: Extracts and caches the full, normalized, and immediate text content from a DOM element or shadow root.

methods.name: elementMatchesText
methods.description: Checks if an element's text content matches a given text matcher, considering its children and shadow DOM.

methods.name: getElementLabels
methods.description: Retrieves label texts associated with an element via ARIA or label elements.
